data.body:
[P2] Distinguish interrupted response bodies from invalid JSON

`response.json()` reads the body as well as parsing it. If the connection fails after successful HTTP headers arrive, this catch converts the transport failure into `DeciderInvalidResponseError`. Before the deadline expires, the default strategy treats that error as permanent and fails without retrying. Separate body reading from parsing: report interrupted reads as retryable transport failures and reserve `DeciderInvalidResponseError` for malformed content. Add coverage for an interrupted successful response.
